pageDescription: Research articles and preprints across quantum information science
paragraphs: My work spans quantum foundations, quantum information, and theoretical and experimental quantum optics, with a particular focus on optical quantum information processing. My publication record includes two articles in *Physical Review X*, two in *Physical Review Letters*, three in *Quantum*, and two in *Physical Review Research*, alongside publications in *New Journal of Physics*, *npj Quantum Information*, *Physical Review A*, *Optics Express*, and other journals.

Papers and preprints are listed below in reverse chronological order. For the most current record, see [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/a/zhang_y_54.html) and [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=nbA1QlUAAAAJ&hl=en). An asterisk denotes co-first authorship.
